tag: 女子站在公園碎石步道上舉起相機拍照，左側有木長椅

level.why: 單人單一動作題，使用基本現在進行式，並含 gravel path 這類簡單地點片語。

image_prompt: A realistic photograph of a woman taking a photo in a park. Natural lighting, 4:3 landscape orientation, sharp focus, clean and simple composition, in the style of a TOEIC Part 1 photo. Composition: A simple, uncluttered scene with one clear main subject doing one obvious action (or one obvious object), a plain background and only a few common objects. No text, signs, logos or brand names anywhere; no readable screens or papers; no celebrities; at most 4 people, with natural proportions, normal hands and fingers, and simple, clearly visible hand actions.
visible_facts: One woman is standing on a gravel path in a park.
She is holding a camera up to her face.
She is wearing a navy long-sleeve top and gray pants.
A wooden bench is on the left beside the path.
Grass and tall trees are in the background.

pool.t: The woman is taking a photo.
pool.why: 正解：女子舉著相機對著前方拍照，與畫面相符。

pool.t: She is holding a camera up to her face.
pool.why: 正解：女子雙手拿著相機貼近臉部，與畫面相符。

pool.t: The woman is standing on a gravel path.
pool.zh: 這名女子正站在碎石步道上。
pool.why: 正解：女子站在公園的碎石步道上，與畫面相符。

pool.t: The woman is riding a bicycle.
pool.zh: 這名女子正在騎腳踏車。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有腳踏車，她是站著拍照。

pool.t: The woman is sitting on the bench.
pool.zh: 這名女子正坐在長椅上。
pool.why: 長椅在左側，但她是站在步道上，沒有坐著。

pool.t: She is walking her dog on the path.
pool.why: 畫面中沒有狗，她也沒有在走動。

pool.t: Some children are playing on the grass.
pool.zh: 一些孩子正在草地上玩耍。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有孩子，只有一名女子。

pool.t: The woman is carrying a red umbrella.
pool.zh: 這名女子正拿著一把紅傘。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有雨傘，她手上拿的是相機。

pool.t: She is talking on the phone.
pool.why: talking 與 taking、phone 與 photo 音近，但她是在拍照，不是講電話。

pool.t: Two women are standing on the path.
pool.zh: 兩名女子正站在步道上。
pool.why: 畫面中只有一名女子，人數錯誤。

pool.t: The woman is standing on a city street.
pool.zh: 這名女子正站在城市街道上。
pool.why: 背景是有樹木和草地的公園，不是城市街道。

pool.t: She is a tourist visiting the park.
pool.zh: 她是來公園參觀的遊客。
pool.why: 畫面看不出她的身分是否為遊客，這是過度推論。
